questions.stem_text:
Cerium(III) sulfate, Ce 2(SO 4)2, is less soluble in hot water than it is in cold. Which
of the following conclusions may be related to this?

options.A: The hydration energies of cerium ions and sulfate ions are very high.
options.B: The heat of solution of cerium(III) sulfate is isothermic.
options.C: The solubility of cerium(III) sulfate increases with temperature.
options.D: The heat of solution of cerium(III) sulfate is exothermic.
options.E: The hydration energies of cerium ions and sulfate ions are very low.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - The heat of solution of cerium(III) sulfate is exothermic.
